info.question: What is Pizzarte?
info.title: PIZZARTE
info.text:
Pizzarte is a pizzeria in Aveiro, at Rua Eng. Von Haff nº27, with three decades of history bringing together great cooking, tradition and the values of the city.

It's a place visited by several generations — for many, it has the best pizzas in town — and a symbol of Aveiro's identity.

From Monday to Sunday you'll find a wide variety of pizzas, salads, pastas and desserts, served by a young, enthusiastic team.

ourSpace.question: What space does Pizzarte have, and what events does it host?
ourSpace.title: Our Space
ourSpace.text:
Pizzarte covers 800m² and seats 200 people — and it's usually full. At weekends, it's common to wait for a table.

The space is big and versatile enough to host events without stopping the restaurant's normal activity: it has held mini concerts, theatre performances, show cooking, children's plays and chess tournaments, among other activities.

If you're visiting Aveiro and love pizza, Pizzarte is a must.

chessIntro.question: Why is there chess at Pizzarte?
chessIntro.title: CHESS TOURNAMENTS
chessIntro.text:
Chess has been part of Pizzarte since 1988, with the famous board created by artist Pedro Andrade — still there today.

Besides the board, the restaurant hosts regular tournaments.
